target.title: feat(gateway): system change history RPC and Ask OpenClaw recent-changes panel
target.body:
Related: #110896

## What Problem This Solves

The config change journal (#111147) records every config mutation — but nothing reads it. Operators still cannot see "what changed on my system, when, by whom" anywhere in the product.

## Why This Change Was Made

Phase 3 of #110896:

- **`openclaw.changes.list`** (additive gateway method, `operator.admin`, Swift/Kotlin protocol clients regenerated): merges the `system-agent-audit` and `config-audit` journals newest-first into typed `SystemChangeEntry` rows (`operation` / `config-write` / `external-edit`, closed source union incl. argv-classified legacy writes). System-agent operations collapse with their matching config write (same hash transition within a 60s window) so one change shows once, enriched with its paths.
- **Robust pagination**: opaque cursors freeze both journal heads on the first page (concurrent writes cannot reorder later pages), advance through scanned-but-filtered ranges, carry bounded collapse-suppression markers (with the causal window re-checked at consumption), and cap raw rows scanned per request at 1000/scope so a 50k-row journal cannot stall the gateway event loop — short pages with a `nextCursor` resume cheaply. Ordering is canonical store-insertion order; payload timestamps are display-only (skewed producer clocks cannot break the page contract).
- **Custodian UI**: a History button (shown only when the gateway advertises the method) opens a "Recent changes" panel — source badges (system-agent / doctor / Settings / CLI / plugin install / manual edit), relative times, expandable changed paths, a warning style for manual edits that broke validation, opaque-change note, and cursor-driven Load more.
- **Store**: `latest({limit, beforeSequence})` bounded newest-first reads on the shared audit record store (no full-scope loads).
- Docs: "Change history" section in `docs/cli/openclaw.md` (what is recorded, bounds, path-only privacy).

## User Impact

Ask OpenClaw now answers the most common ops mystery visually: who changed the config and when — including hand edits made while the gateway was offline, marked invalid when they broke validation.

![history panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/custodian-shared-chat/history-panel.png)

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/server-methods/system-changes.test.ts` — 10 tests pass (merge/collapse/skip, argv classification, newest-first with suppression markers + causal window, clock-rollback ordering, frozen heads across pages, bounded-scan regression with counting store).
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/pages/custodian` — 38 tests pass (gating, panel, cards, expansion, short-page Load more, refresh-on-reopen).
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/sqlite-audit-record-store.test.ts` — 7 pass (`latest()` bounds).
- `pnpm protocol:gen` + `:swift` + `:kotlin` + `pnpm protocol:check` — clean; `pnpm ui:i18n:baseline` run (en.ts only).
- Screenshot above from a mocked-gateway Playwright session.
- Autoreview (codex/gpt-5.6-sol, xhigh): five cycles to clean — final pass reports no accepted/actionable findings.
